actions.name: puzzle
actions.description: Say today's word puzzle: the mixed-up letters and the clue ("what's today's word puzzle?").

actions.name: hint
actions.description: One more hint for today's word puzzle ("give me a hint"). Say what it answers, and nothing more: don't give the word away.

actions.name: guess
actions.description: Someone's guess at today's word puzzle ("is it penguin?").

actions.name: reveal
actions.description: Give up and say today's word, only when they ask for the answer.
